notes: Read-only routes. No route here calls /api/project/switch, goes through the workspace runtime, or writes a store. They ignore X-Compose-Workspace-Id and the UI sends none (plain fetch, not wsFetch).

Mounted only in local mode, next to /api/process. With `projects.roots` absent from the host's .compose/compose.json, /api/projects answers {configured:false, projects:[]} and /api/fleet/roots keeps its legacy payload.

response.configured: boolean: the host config has projects.roots

projects.name: string: project.name, else the root folder name
projects.label: string
projects.root: string: realpath of the project root
projects.hasStore: boolean: <root>/.compose/data/vision-state.json exists and the root's capabilities.lifecycle !== false

lanes.label: string
lanes.module: string|null: a modules[].name of this project

modules.name: string
modules.hasStore: boolean: derived on read, never written
modules.error: string|null: e.g. claimed by an earlier project; an errored module contributes nothing

errors: string: visible on Projects home, never silent

query.lane: optional lane id: echoed back as focus

items: a vision item as the store holds it, with: id = '<member>:<storeId>', module = '<member>' (the root store's member is the project name), memberRoot = realpath of the owning store's root

modules: string: the lane's module names; empty = whole project

rules: Collision on featureCode: a module store beats the root store (owner Q1 2026-11-01: the module store is the truth). Between modules, the one with <features>/<CODE>/ on disk wins, then config order. The loser is dropped and its edges are re-pointed to the winner.
Root-store track items titled like a configured module are dropped: modules[] replaces them.
A member whose capabilities.lifecycle is false contributes no items.

query.id: a namespaced item id from the graph route

response.path: string: absolute path inside the owning member's root

rules: DOC-LINKS on the merged graph: the item's design.md, else its first file, resolved against the OWNING member's root. A path that escapes that root, or a missing file, is 404.
